name: Nexsland
description:
A living, morphing status island that hangs from the top bar.

- Now Playing, volume and brightness, battery, Bluetooth, network, Do Not Disturb, screen recording, microphone in use and downloads
- Opens on hover into a tabbed panel: timer, calendar, system stats and an opt-in, memory-only clipboard history
- Optional lock screen display and NexTile integration

Report bugs at https://github.com/fresp/nexsland/issues
